I've successfully created the 10-second 3D prototype using Blender's Python API. 

The scene includes an isometric "Monument Valley" styled environment with colorful sunset lighting, stepping stones, and multiple perfectly proportioned blocky characters (with fingers) who walk and look around. 

The frames were rendered to a PNG sequence to avoid enum crashes and then successfully stitched together with FFMPEG. The final output has been copied to:
`C:\Users\renu5\.gemini\antigravity\brain\6f71b575-d73e-4413-b861-a66d8f356c8c\Concept2_Blender.mp4`
